name: claude-usage
title: Claude Usage
description: Shows Claude Code usage limits in the menu bar
author: zeev

commands.name: usage
commands.title: Claude Usage
commands.description: Shows session, weekly, and credit usage for Claude Code

preferences.name: refreshSeconds
preferences.title: Refresh Frequency
preferences.description: How often to fetch fresh usage from Anthropic. Raycast wakes the command every minute; between fetches the last response is replayed from cache. The endpoint is rate limited, so longer intervals are gentler.
